test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Five friends A, B, C, D and E are sitting in a line, all facing north. E is sitting to the immediate left of B. A is sitting to the immediate right of C. D is to the immediate right of B. B is third to the left of A. Who is sitting at the third place to the right of E?
solution:
**Five friends: **A, B, C, D, and E

1) E is sitting to the immediate left of B.

2) D is to the immediate right of B.

(These three case are possible)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ff47ae0c5ed4faf81a02d60a5199597c54d1b781de8bdc7ff574eb1912edae68.png] 

3) B is third to the left of A.

(Case-3 & Case-2 are eliminated because, B is third left from A and Only Case-1 is possible)

4) A is sitting to the immediate right of C.

(Only one place are left for A)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1685dea9b4fe47fd0b2a7ee394c45a2c49fb8909bd54379bfabdc689d65c4b28.png] 

So, **"C" **is sitting at the third place to the right of E.

Hence, the correct answer is **"C".**
